view: Oblique ground-level view Troy Hisarlik excavated sloping battered limestone fortification wall, exposed stratified trench and low later foundations behind, dry grass Aegean landscape, no wooden horse, no intact citadel.

eras.title: Cities built over cities
eras.caption: At Hisarlık, excavators found successive settlements built on the same hill. The exposed walls and layers show why Troy cannot be understood as the remains of just one city or one war.
